title: Term Exam — General Science Term 1
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which of these is NOT one of the four life areas improved by physics in this course?
options: Astronomy research
Household
Health and safety
Work productivity at the job
questions.correct: Astronomy research

questions.text: An electric fan makes a room feel cooler. Which area of life does this MAINLY improve?
options: Household comfort
Work productivity in factories
Health and safety on roads
Leisure in sports competitions
questions.correct: Household comfort

questions.text: Why do helmets reduce head injuries in motorcycle crashes?
options: They spread the force and lengthen the impact time
They make the rider's head much lighter during a crash
They stop air from pushing on the rider's head
They increase the speed so the rider lands faster
questions.correct: They spread the force and lengthen the impact time

questions.text: A conveyor belt in a factory moves boxes faster than workers can carry them. Which area does physics improve here?
options: Work productivity
Household chores
Health and safety
Leisure and sports events
questions.correct: Work productivity

questions.text: Which physics-based device lets a doctor listen to a patient's heartbeat?
options: Stethoscope
Thermometer
Microscope
Barometer
questions.correct: Stethoscope

questions.text: A family can buy only one: a smoke detector or a bigger television. Based on physics in daily life, which is the BEST choice and why?
options: Smoke detector — it gives early warning that saves lives
Television — brighter screens improve eyesight at home
Television — it uses physics, while detectors use chemistry
Smoke detector — it makes the house cooler at night
questions.correct: Smoke detector — it gives early warning that saves lives

questions.text: Angular velocity is measured in which unit?
options: Radians per second
Meters per second
Newtons per square meter
Joules per second
questions.correct: Radians per second

questions.text: Which object shows rotational motion only?
options: A spinning top that stays in one spot
A ball thrown straight up into the air
A jeepney driving on a straight road
A ball rolling across the basketball court
questions.correct: A spinning top that stays in one spot

questions.text: Why does a point on the rim of a wheel move faster than a point near the axle?
options: It is farther from the axis, so v = rω is larger
It has a much greater angular velocity than the axle
It is heavier, so gravity pulls it faster around
It slips on the road while the axle stays still
questions.correct: It is farther from the axis, so v = rω is larger

questions.text: One complete revolution equals how many degrees?
A Ferris wheel of radius 20 m turns at 0.1 rad/s. How fast does a rider on the rim move?
options: 2 m/s
questions.correct: 2 m/s

questions.text: Two gears turn together. Gear A has a radius of 5 cm and Gear B 10 cm. Their rims move at the same linear speed. Which is TRUE?
options: Gear A turns twice as fast as Gear B
Gear B turns twice as fast as Gear A
Both gears turn at the same rate
Gear A turns half as fast as Gear B
questions.correct: Gear A turns twice as fast as Gear B

questions.text: Torque is calculated using which formula?
options: τ = F × r
τ = F ÷ r
τ = m × a
τ = F + r
questions.correct: τ = F × r

questions.text: Why is it easier to open a jar with a rubber grip around the lid?
options: More friction lets your hand apply more torque
The rubber makes the lid much lighter
The grip reduces the radius of the lid so it turns easily
The rubber heats the lid so it expands
questions.correct: More friction lets your hand apply more torque

questions.text: What does a mechanical advantage greater than 1 mean?
options: The machine multiplies the input force
The machine creates extra energy
The machine works without any friction
The machine reduces the output force
questions.correct: The machine multiplies the input force

questions.text: A screwdriver with a thick handle turns screws more easily than one with a thin handle. Why?
options: A larger radius gives more torque for the same grip force
A thick handle makes the metal tip much harder
A thin handle has more friction against the hand
A thick handle makes the screw turn faster all by itself, with no force
questions.correct: A larger radius gives more torque for the same grip force

questions.text: A machine uses 500 J of input work and produces 400 J of useful output. What is its efficiency?
Two student designs lift the same load. Design X has efficiency 60%; Design Y has 85% but needs a longer rope. Which judgment is BEST?
options: Y — it wastes less energy, even with more rope
X — a lower efficiency means a stronger machine
X — shorter rope always means better design
Y — longer ropes create more energy
questions.correct: Y — it wastes less energy, even with more rope

questions.text: Why do pressure in a liquid and the depth of a diver increase together?
options: More water above pushes down with greater weight
Water becomes thinner and lighter as it goes deeper
Pressure in water is the same at every depth
Fish push the water downward toward the diver
questions.correct: More water above pushes down with greater weight

questions.text: How do hydraulic brakes in a jeepney stop all four wheels at once?
options: Pressure from the pedal is passed equally through the fluid
Each wheel has its own separate engine for braking
Air is squeezed in the brake lines until all the wheels lock and stop
The driver pulls a cable tied to each of the wheels
questions.correct: Pressure from the pedal is passed equally through the fluid

questions.text: Which unit is used for pressure?
options: Pascal (N/m²)
Newton (N)
Joule per second (J/s)
Watt (W)
questions.correct: Pascal (N/m²)

questions.text: Why do wide tires on a tractor keep it from sinking in mud?
options: Larger area spreads its weight, lowering pressure
Wider tires make the tractor much lighter
Mud has much more friction against the wide rubber tires
Wide tires raise the pressure on the mud
questions.correct: Larger area spreads its weight, lowering pressure

questions.text: A 900 N person stands on two feet with a total area of 0.03 m². What pressure does he exert on the floor?
options: 27 Pa
300 Pa

questions.text: In a hydraulic jack, a 100 N effort lifts a 2,000 N load. If the small piston's area is 0.002 m², what is the large piston's area?
options: 0.4 m²

questions.text: What is the speed of light in a vacuum?
Why does a diamond sparkle more than glass?
options: It bends and reflects light strongly inside
It makes its own light from heat
It absorbs all colors of light except pure white light
It stops light from passing through it
questions.correct: It bends and reflects light strongly inside

questions.text: Which part of the electromagnetic spectrum can our eyes detect?
options: Visible light
Radio waves
Ultraviolet rays
X-rays
questions.correct: Visible light

questions.text: How does a GPS receiver in a phone find its position?
options: It times radio signals from several satellites
It listens for sound echoes from the ground
It measures how much sunlight hits the phone's screen
It reads magnetic lines from the North Pole
questions.correct: It times radio signals from several satellites

questions.text: A barcode scanner uses a red laser and not a regular flashlight. What is the MAIN reason?
options: Its narrow beam reads thin lines clearly
Its beam is hotter and burns the code
It is louder, so the cashier can hear it clearly
It works without any electrical power
questions.correct: Its narrow beam reads thin lines clearly

questions.text: A family wants to cut its electric bill. Which lighting choice is BEST supported by science?
options: Switch to LEDs, which waste less energy as heat
Use incandescent bulbs, which give more light per watt
Keep lights on all day, since switching wastes power
Use colored bulbs, since red light uses no electricity
questions.correct: Switch to LEDs, which waste less energy as heat

questions.text: Sound waves are classified as which kind of wave?
options: Longitudinal mechanical waves
Transverse electromagnetic waves
Longitudinal electromagnetic waves
Transverse light-like waves
questions.correct: Longitudinal mechanical waves

questions.text: Why can't sound travel through outer space?
options: There are no particles to carry the vibration
Space is too cold for any vibration to happen
Starlight cancels out all sound waves
Gravity pulls sound waves back to planets
questions.correct: There are no particles to carry the vibration

questions.text: Sound with a frequency above 20,000 Hz is called what?
options: Ultrasound
Infrasound
Microwave
Radio wave
questions.correct: Ultrasound

questions.text: Why does a voice sound louder through a microphone and speaker system?
options: The amplifier increases the wave's amplitude
The speaker increases the speed of sound
The microphone raises the pitch of the speaker's voice
The amplifier changes sound into light
questions.correct: The amplifier increases the wave's amplitude

questions.text: A sound wave in air has a frequency of 686 Hz. Sound travels 343 m/s. What is its wavelength?
options: 2 m

questions.text: A dolphin and a submarine both use sound to find objects underwater. What do they have in common?
options: Both time echoes to judge distance
Both use light pulses to see in water
Both make sounds only below 20 Hz
Both need air to send out their signals
questions.correct: Both time echoes to judge distance

questions.text: Pasteur's experiment used a flask with what special shape?
options: An S-shaped swan neck
A wide, open mouth
A tightly sealed lid
A flat, square bottom
questions.correct: An S-shaped swan neck

questions.text: What does germ theory state?
options: Microorganisms cause many diseases
Diseases come from bad-smelling air
Germs are created from spoiled food
Illness is caused by cold weather
questions.correct: Microorganisms cause many diseases

questions.text: Why is UHT milk safe to store unopened for months?
options: Very high heat killed nearly all microbes before sealing
It contains strong chemicals that poison every germ
It was frozen solid before it was put in the box and sealed
Its box lets air in to keep microbes from growing
questions.correct: Very high heat killed nearly all microbes before sealing

questions.text: Pasteurization is named after which scientist?
options: Louis Pasteur
Robert Koch
Sir Isaac Newton
Marie Curie
questions.correct: Louis Pasteur

questions.text: Why did Pasteur's swan-neck design make a FAIR test against spontaneous generation?
options: Air reached the broth, but microbes were kept out
The broth was sealed tightly so no air could enter it
Two different broths were used in each flask
The flask was kept in the dark the whole time
questions.correct: Air reached the broth, but microbes were kept out

questions.text: Which statement BEST shows the lasting value of Pasteur's work today?
options: Vaccines and pasteurized food still prevent disease
His flasks are still used today in every hospital ward
He proved that diseases come from the stars
His ideas replaced the need for clean water
questions.correct: Vaccines and pasteurized food still prevent disease

questions.text: What is the function of the surfactant in shampoo?
options: Removes oil and dirt from hair
Adds color to the hair strands
Kills lice living on the scalp
Makes the hair grow much faster
questions.correct: Removes oil and dirt from hair

questions.text: Why should household chemicals be kept in their original containers?
options: The label gives ingredients, warnings and first aid
Original bottles keep the chemicals much stronger for years
Other bottles make the chemicals turn into gas
The FDA collects all of the original bottles
questions.correct: The label gives ingredients, warnings and first aid

questions.text: Which agency issues advisories against unregistered cosmetics?
options: FDA
DENR
DTI
DOTr
questions.correct: FDA

questions.text: Why does baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) help fluffy pancakes rise?
options: It reacts with acid to release CO₂ bubbles
It adds air when the batter is stirred
It melts and spreads the batter apart
It absorbs water and then swells up into a thick foam
questions.correct: It reacts with acid to release CO₂ bubbles

questions.text: Fish die in a lake after algae spread across its surface. Which cause-and-effect chain is correct?
options: Excess phosphates → algae bloom → decay uses up oxygen
Algae bloom → more oxygen → fish grow too fast and die
Soap foam → blocks heat → water freezes the fish
Detergent → makes water salty → fish lose their scales
questions.correct: Excess phosphates → algae bloom → decay uses up oxygen

questions.text: A store sells a whitening cream with no FDA notification number at a very low price. What is the BEST decision?
options: Do not buy it — its safety has not been checked
Buy it — low prices mean fewer chemicals inside
Buy it — whitening creams are always safe
Do not buy it — only because it is too cheap
questions.correct: Do not buy it — its safety has not been checked

questions.text: In a battery, the process in which an atom LOSES electrons is called what?
options: Oxidation
Reduction
Condensation
Combustion
questions.correct: Oxidation

questions.text: Why does an aircon's outdoor unit blow warm air?
options: The refrigerant gives off room heat as it condenses
The compressor burns gasoline to run the fan
Warm air is made on purpose to balance the indoor cold air
The fan rubs the air until it becomes hot
questions.correct: The refrigerant gives off room heat as it condenses

questions.text: Which step in cooking an egg is mainly CHEMISTRY?
options: The egg proteins denature and turn solid
Heat flows from the flame into the pan
The pan conducts heat to the eggshell and egg white
Boiling water circulates by convection
questions.correct: The egg proteins denature and turn solid

questions.text: A solar panel changes light energy into which form of energy?
options: Electrical energy
Stored chemical energy
Sound energy
Nuclear energy
questions.correct: Electrical energy

questions.text: A phone battery heats up while fast-charging. Which explanation correctly combines physics and chemistry?
options: Current drives the reaction, and some energy becomes heat
The battery burns oxygen inside, making a small flame
The charger sends heat through the cable wire into the phone
The phone screen absorbs light and warms the battery
questions.correct: Current drives the reaction, and some energy becomes heat

questions.text: Design a low-cost way for a coastal family to get safe drinking water during floods. Which plan BEST uses both sciences?
options: Let water settle, filter it through cloth, then boil it
Drink floodwater after it cools in a covered drum
Add salt to the floodwater, then store it under the hot sun
Freeze the floodwater and eat the ice right away
questions.correct: Let water settle, filter it through cloth, then boil it

questions.text: Which formula gives the output force of a hydraulic system?
options: F₂ = F₁ × (A₂ ÷ A₁)
F₂ = F₁ × (A₁ ÷ A₂)
F₂ = F₁ + A₂ − A₁
F₂ = F₁ ÷ (A₁ × A₂)
questions.correct: F₂ = F₁ × (A₂ ÷ A₁)

questions.text: What do a lever, a pulley and a hydraulic jack all have in common?
options: They trade distance for force
They create energy from nothing
They work only with liquids
They need electricity to work
questions.correct: They trade distance for force

questions.text: Which pair correctly matches a wave to its use in medicine?
options: Ultrasound — imaging a baby in the womb
X-ray — measuring hearing ability
Radio wave — cleaning teeth by vibration
Sound wave — killing germs in milk
questions.correct: Ultrasound — imaging a baby in the womb

questions.text: Which idea links pasteurization and cooking an egg?
options: Heat changes the shape of proteins
Light breaks proteins into simple sugars
Cold makes proteins grow faster
Sound waves dissolve the proteins
questions.correct: Heat changes the shape of proteins

questions.text: Electrical energy used by appliances is billed in which unit?
options: Kilowatt-hour (kWh)
Kilogram (kg)
Kilopascal per hour (kPa/h)
Kilohertz (kHz)
questions.correct: Kilowatt-hour (kWh)

questions.text: A 1.5 kW aircon runs 8 hours a day. How much energy does it use in one day?
options: 12 kWh
5.3 kWh
9.5 kWh
120 kWh
questions.correct: 12 kWh
